articles.title_en: Russian general who briefed Putin on capture of Kostiantynivka killed in Ukraine
articles.lead_en: Russian Major General Anton Grunis, commander of the 4th Motorized Rifle Brigade of the Southern Group of Forces, has been killed, Lieutenant General Apti Alaudinov confirmed after Ukrainian and Russian sources had already reported his death. Alaudinov is deputy head of the Main Military-Political Directorate of Russia’s Armed Forces and commander of the Akhmat unit.

articles.title_en: Russian drone strikes bus in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region, killing 5
articles.lead_en: A Russian drone strike on a passenger bus in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region killed five people and injured seven others, Governor Oleksandr Hanzha said.

articles.title_en: Russian forces strike Kyiv, setting warehouse on fire and injuring one
articles.lead_en: Russian forces struck Kyiv with jet-propelled drones overnight on September 16, Ukrainska Pravda reported. In Kyiv’s Sviatoshynskyi District, a warehouse caught fire after “drone debris” fell, injuring one person, local authorities said.

articles.title_en: Kremlin calls energy truce ‘a very good idea’ but says it ‘won’t solve the world’s problems’
articles.lead_en: Russian officials are calling the energy ceasefire proposed by the U.S. president — a mutual pledge by Russia and Ukraine to stop striking each other’s energy infrastructure — “a very good idea,” Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov told reporters.

articles.title_en: Ukrainian military strikes Ozon warehouse and oil refinery in Russia
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones and missiles struck Taganrog overnight on September 15, damaging a warehouse belonging to the marketplace Ozon along with several residential buildings, stores, and administrative buildings, Rostov Governor Yuri Slyusar said. No one was injured, according to the governor.

articles.title_en: Ukraine wants homegrown missiles capable of striking deep inside Russia, including Moscow, but its existing ‘Flamingos’ show how hard mass production can be
articles.lead_en: On September 11, Fire Point, Ukraine’s leading manufacturer of long-range strike weapons, said it was ready to supply the military with the FP-7 short-range ballistic missile. The FP-7 is intended to replace — or supplement — the well-known ATACMS.
